verdict.rationale: Conductor documents a public API for managing cloud workspaces programmatically and a hosted MCP server for MCP clients to control workspaces, directly supporting AI-native/API-driven control. However, there is no OpenAPI/swagger spec found (404s on probes), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of API usage beyond first-party docs. Missing for 10: publicly discoverable API schema (OpenAPI spec), independent verification of the API/MCP server in practice.
